name: PRISM: Thereafter
source:
Thanks to an unruly stroke of luck, you're stuck in a futureless country where the Government's sworn to ruin. In a last ditch attempt to make yourself of use to literally just anyone or anything at this point, you decide to join the Government's Testing program, your lifeless, frozen shell enduring tests until the day you manage to wake, 50 years in the future.

After one thing and another, you find yourself in front of New Halcyon's Hit Up-And-Coming Company in which you'll meet men and women who share your vision in Game Development and Entertainment! 

Will you survive the transition into futuristic society, or will you find a striking man to call the one you love?

[Edited from [url=https://ezekielsbox.itch.io/prism-thereafter]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
由于运气不好，你被困在一个没有未来的国家，政府誓言要毁灭这里。为了让自己对任何人或任何事有用，你做了最后的尝试，决定加入政府的测试计划，你的死气沉沉、冰冻的外壳将承受测试，直到50年后你醒来的那一天。

一件又一件事情之后，你发现自己来到了New Halcyon的热门新兴公司面前，在那里你将遇到与你在游戏开发和娱乐方面有着共同愿景的男男女女！

你会在未来社会的过渡中幸存下来，还是会找到一个引人注目的男人来称呼你所爱的人？

[编辑自[url=https://ezekielsbox.itch.io/prism-thereafter]itch.io[/url]]
